resources.string: A journey outside. An awakening within.

What if the reason to set out on a journey were not simply to arrive somewhere, but to awaken?

Travel to Awaken is more than a way to fill the time on the road. It is an invitation to travel with purpose: to listen, learn, rediscover, enjoy and grow. The road is not an obligation to endure, but an opportunity we can look forward to.

Our symbol tells this story: the blue road represents our journey through the world; the green sprout represents our growth within. Together they express the unseen meaning of travel — awakening.

Set out on a journey. Not only to reach a new place, but to discover something new within yourself.
